title: Nazi discs brought to US via Operation Paperclip
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Nazi discs brought to US via Operation Paperclip, about 1940s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: based off of like even, for example, when they retrieved the stuff from Nazi Germany back in the ' 40s and then sent them over here with Operation Paperclip.

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, mentions what he has heard about the 1940s. He says material was recovered from Nazi Germany and sent to the United States through Operation Paperclip, the American programme that brought German scientists and technology over after the Second World War. In this story, that included disc-shaped craft, which would mean the US inherited early saucer technology from the Nazis.
